heading: About My
bio:
As a Computer Science and Engineering student, I am deeply passionate about Network Engineering and the architecture of resilient IT Infrastructure. My core focus lies in the end-to-end lifecycle of network systems—from initial design and configuration to proactive maintenance and complex troubleshooting.

I am currently advancing my technical proficiency through CCNA and MikroTik training, actively translating theoretical concepts into robust, hands-on architectures using Cisco Packet Tracer. My technical foundation encompasses Routing & Switching, VLANs, Trunking, Inter-VLAN Routing, TCP/IP, Subnetting, VLSM, DHCP, DNS, NAT, Routing Protocols, and EtherChannel.

In addition to my networking focus, my background in Full-Stack Web Development (MERN stack, React, Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB) provides me with a holistic view of the technology stack. This dual perspective enables me to understand exactly how applications, servers, and end-users interact with and depend on the underlying network infrastructure.

I am actively seeking entry-level opportunities in Network Engineering where I can leverage my problem-solving skills, collaborate with seasoned IT professionals, and contribute to the optimization and security of real-world enterprise environments.
